title.narrative: UNODC- HIV and AIDS Prevention- Prison Settings in Sub-Saharan Africa 2011-2014
UNODC- Hiv - fängelser i AFrika söder om Sahara 2011-2014

description.narrative: The intervention aims towards furthering developing and increasing the sustainability of responses, as well as initiating a service delivery approach to HIV in prisons in benefiting countries in sub Saharan Africa based on Zambia set-up service as model. And, its lessons learned and sharing of good practices between countries through direct duplication of activity implementation and ongoing provision of technical support and assistance.

UNODC har ansökt om förlängning av stöd med 4,950,000 SEK från SIDA för sitt ”HIV/AIDS arbete med prevention, behandling, omsorg och stöd i fängelsemiljöer söder om Sahara, Afrika, 2011-214” Projektet är förlagt till söder om Sahara, Afrika i (Angola, Etiopien, Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique, Namibia, Swazilan Tanzania (inkluderat Zanzibar), Zambia och Zimbabwe) under 2015. Insatsen syfte är att förbättra omhändertagandet/sjukvården i fängelser söder om Sahara och som ingår i projektet därmed kommer att vara bidragsmottagare.
Insatsens totala budget uppgår till 4,950,000 SEK

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2016Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: In the reporting period increased focus has been put on advocating among parliamentarians and other policy makers, especially to support the national implementation of the Southern African Development Community (SADC) Minimum Standards and UNODC comprehensive package of interventions. UNODC has continuously prioritised the collection and use of strategic information to inform policy and strategy development, as well as the implementation of evidence based interventions in prison settings.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
